summary: Retested the two fixes from iteration 42: (1) brute-force remaining-count threshold and (2) tenant-aware logout redirect. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_brute_force_and_auth.py: 9/9 PASSED. Frontend Playwright: admin and worker logout now correctly land on /beauty-studio-bor/admin/login (previously /login) - BOTH FIXED. Brute-force UI flow verified end-to-end: attempts 1-3 generic 'Pogrešan email ili lozinka', attempt 4 'Pogrešan email ili lozinka (1 pokušaj(a) preostalo)', attempt 5 '...privremeno zaključan na 15 minuta...', attempt 6 '...Pokušajte ponovo za 14 min 57 sek.'. Per-email independent counters and counter-clear-on-success verified via API. Regression: admin dashboard nav (Rezervacije/Crna Lista/Radnici/Usluge/Podešavanja) works with zero console errors; worker dashboard read-only single-column calendar with only 'Rezervacije' + RADNIK badge; /api/workers/account-statuses returns 200 for admin, 403 for worker. Auth hygiene: all password hashes are $2b$12$, httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies set on login, app-level CORS returns explicit origin with allow-credentials=true.

minor.issue: allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, "*"] with allow_credentials=True - the literal "*" should be removed (invalid with credentials, security smell). Still unfixed from iteration 42.

_login_attempts is a module-level in-memory dict: lost on restart, not multi-worker safe, never garbage-collected (unbounded growth), and 'first_attempt' is stored but never used so non-locked counters never expire.

No seed_admin routine found in backend (grep for 'seed_admin' returns nothing); admin/worker users exist in Mongo but there is no idempotent re-seed/update-password path as described in the playbook checklist.

issues: Login page uses a blue/navy theme while the admin dashboard uses the gold/dark salon theme - branding inconsistency (cosmetic, pre-existing)

action_items: Remove the literal "*" from CORS allow_origins while allow_credentials=True.
Optional hardening: give the brute-force tracker TTL cleanup or move it to Mongo/Redis so it survives restarts and cannot grow unbounded.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute now correctly derives loginPath from useParams().slug - verified. ProtectedSuperAdmin still hardcodes /login, which is correct for super-admin routes.
AdminDashboard.handleLogout's navigate() is now redundant given the ProtectedRoute redirect, but harmless.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (logout redirect admin+worker, brute-force UI 6 stages, admin nav regression, worker read-only dashboard)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Throwaway in-memory lockout emails used: bruteforce-*@example.com (pytest, random), bf-iter43-ui@x.com (UI, locked ~15 min in memory only). admin@salon.com exercised with 3 wrong attempts then reset by successful login (verified generic message afterwards). worker@salon.com not locked.
test_credentials: admin@salon.com / Admin123!, worker@salon.com / Worker123! - both valid
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_brute_force_and_auth.py -v -p no:randomly. Threshold is now remaining<=1 (counter only from 4th attempt) and matches tests. bf-iter43-ui@x.com is locked in-memory for ~15 min; 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend' clears all lockouts. Logout redirect fix lives in ProtectedRoute (App.js:153-167) using useParams().slug. Remaining open items are non-blocking: CORS wildcard entry and in-memory tracker durability.
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported bugs are resolved. Previous logout bug RCA (ProtectedRoute hardcoding /login) was addressed by building loginPath from the slug route param; brute-force message leak was addressed by changing the condition to remaining <= 1.
